class.name: IfcTextStyleForDefinedFont
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-46:1992 : A text style for defined font is a character glyph style for pre-defined or externally defined text fonts. Definition from CSS1 (W3C Recommendation) : These properties describe the color (often called foreground color) and background of an element (i.e. the surface onto which the content is rendered). members.member: This property describes the text color of an element (often referred to as the foreground color).
This property sets the background color of an element.
